board: GY-906 MLX90614 infrared thermometer module (MLX90614ESF-BAA, 4-pin VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, 662K 3.3 V regulator and pull-ups)
reason: Check PASS on ESP32 and Pico on the first run (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test Obj=37.0C Amb=24.0C, DRC-clean PCB, footprint). The sim stores Tobj1 (RAM 0x07) and Ta (RAM 0x06) as LSByte-first words with T = raw*0.02 - 273.15 C, as the datasheet specifies. The driver does an SMBus read word (command, repeated start, LSB, MSB) with a 100 kHz bus and checks the bit-15 error flag. It skips the optional PEC byte, which the simulator does not produce; the SKILL.md says so.
